marta (docs): Heads-up — PR #4123 adds a migration guide for the model-card schema change (supported_variants -> variants). Need a short compatibility note, an SDK snippet for the new streaming + quantized example, and updated limits table. Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4123
sam (eng-ml): Saw it, I can add benchmark numbers for 8k vs 32k contexts. Will paste results here shortly.
kai (devex): I can draft the Python SDK example and a minimal JS snippet. Do we want both in the same PR or split?
marta (docs): Prefer same PR if the snippets are <20 lines each. Keeps docs in one place. Target EOD Wed for the edits.
sam (eng-ml): Quick bench summary (median latency, a100x4, mixed workload): 8k -> 45ms/token, 32k -> 120ms/token. I'll push the CSV and raw run notes to the PR comment. Note: these are with q4h quantized profile.
nathan (product): Important: add a compatibility note that q4* profiles can show small token-level quality regressions for long-context summarization; recommend fallback to full-precision "zephyr-aurora" for critical accuracy. Also call out Dedicated defaults may differ.
kai (devex): Draft Python snippet (streaming + fallback):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = client.generate("Summarize long doc...", model="zephyr-aurora-q4h", streaming=True, max_tokens=1024)
for chunk in resp.stream():
    print(chunk.text, end='')
# fallback to full-precision if quality check fails
resp_full = client.generate("Summarize long doc...", model="zephyr-aurora", max_tokens=1024)
print(resp_full.text)
```
marta (docs): Nice — please add a one-line comment about 'kv-cache compatibility' for 4-bit variants (sam can confirm wording). Also include a tiny curl example for migration.
sam (eng-ml): Added CSV to PR comment and noted: "KV cache is preserved for q4h for autoregressive generation; micro-batching behaves the same. For certain attention kernels we fall back to fp16 which can change perf slightly." Will post exact numbers and error bars by EOD.
kai (devex): Curl snippet for the migration section: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"zephyr-aurora-q4h","input":"Summarize this long file...","max_tokens":512}'
```
marta (docs): I'll update the model card table: add new column "recommended_profile" and clarify "limits" (max_input_tokens, recommended_batch_size per tier). Can someone sanity-check the numbers I put in?
sam (eng-ml): I will sanity-check the limits and add a short benchmark footnote for 8k/32k. Also calling out memory footprint delta between q4h and fp16.
docs-bot: PR 4123 updated by @marta — reviewers requested: @sam, @kai
nathan (product): Also add a short note in the Dedicated docs that customers can opt into a different default quantization profile per pool. Might be a single-line cross-ref.
marta (docs): Adding that cross-ref now. Thanks everyone. I'll ping for final review once I push the cleaned examples.
kai (devex): Will run the snippets locally against staging and file an issue if something fails. :thumbsup:
